items.summary: Attester identity: 01.06.02 D-02 (the owning, later-ratified decision) forbids publishing it at any tier to any viewer; 01.06.01 and 01.06.03 carried stale breadth-pass prose, an example string and a Happy Path step that name the attester. Aligned all four drifted locations to D-02 and cited it inline.
items.canonicalSource: 01.06.02-credit-backed-portfolio.md:211 — "D-02 | **Evidence class and count publish; attester identity never does — at any tier, to any viewer.** Co-contributors are public (a collaborator is not an attester) | **Corrects the breadth pass** (DT-05)." Reinforced by 01.06.02-credit-backed-portfolio.md:63 (publish table: "**Attester identity** | ❌ **Never, at any tier, to any viewer including authenticated professionals**") and 01.06.02-credit-backed-portfolio.md:50 ("It never carries **who** said it (D-02, DT-05)").
whyMechanical: Only one file holds a numbered decision on this concept. 01.06.02 D-02 owns it; 01.06.01 and 01.06.03 hold no decision on attester visibility at all — their occurrences are narrative prose, a provenance-table gloss and illustrative caption strings.

01.06.02's boundary table (01.06.02-credit-backed-portfolio.md:25) assigns ownership explicitly: "**The portfolio as the attested half of a composed profile** (01.06.01's asserted/attested line) | **This file** | Owner." The attested half's publication rules are 01.06.02's by ratified assignment.

The drifted side is provably the superseded one, in the tree's own words. 01.06.02 DT-05 quotes the exact rejected hypothesis — "Attribution is visible — every credit shows who said it" — sources it as "**This file's own D-02, as written at breadth**", and rejects it as "the most dangerous sentence in this file" on three independent defeaters (moat, privacy, never-needed). The 01.06.01/01.06.03 lines are that same breadth-pass position, left standing because the ratification never swept the siblings.
Dates corroborate: 01.06.02 Last updated 2026-07-23; 01.06.01 2026-07-16; 01.06.03 2026-07-17 (and still [PARTIAL]). Both drifted files predate the correction.
No value was invented. Every replacement uses the tree's own canonical evidence sentence, "Confirmed by 3 people who were there" (01.06.02:39, :61, :117).
items.fixApplied:
Four edits, all on the drifted side; 01.06.02 untouched.

1. 01.06.01:41 — provenance-state table, Attested row, Meaning cell. Was "A named other party said it, on the record, at the time". Now states that the graph holds who but the page never publishes the attester's identity at any tier to any viewer (01.06.02 D-02), and that what renders is the evidence class and count. 3 columns preserved; the "Who can change the fact" cell is unchanged and was already correct.

2. 01.06.01:97 — Happy Path step 8. Was "each showing what this person did on it and **who said so**". Now "**how well it is known** — 'Confirmed by 3 people who were there', never who said it (01.06.02 D-02, DT-05: the booker needs to know independent co-present confirmation exists, not the citer's name)".

3. 01.06.01:135 — Edge Cases, 'Reel clip laundering', User Sees cell. Was "\"Tambourine — 'Song', attested by Sam Reeves\"". Now "\"Tambourine — 'Song' · Confirmed by 3 people who were there\". The **role** travels with the clip; the attester's name never does (01.06.02 D-02)." The remedy itself is unweakened — D-18's mechanism is the role travelling with the clip, and it never required the attester's name. 3 columns preserved.

4. 01.06.03:42 — Happy Path step 5. Was "they can see who attested each one". Now "each carries how well it is known ('Confirmed by 3 people who were there'), never who attested it (01.06.02 D-02: attester identity publishes at no tier, to no viewer, and a named recipient on a no-login link is the least protected viewer there is)". This was the worst instance — 01.06.03 D-03 makes the EPK a no-login public surface, so it published the attester to an unauthenticated stranger.
items.additionalFix: One same-class drift the finding did not cite, fixed for consistency: 01.06.01:168, DT-08's illustrative caption "Drums on 'Song' by 'Artist' — attested by their producer", now "— Confirmed by 3 people who were there", with a clause noting the caption identifies the rightsholder **without naming a single attester** (01.06.02 D-02) because it is the work and the role that point at the rightsholder. DT-08's argument is unweakened: the takedown-targeting hazard comes from the work title, artist and role, none of which changed. Left standing, this example string would let a downstream reader re-derive the rejected published-attester pattern from a caption.
notFixed: 01.06.01:109 — "Added by Sam Reeves" on an unclaimed party's header. Not the same concept and not a contradiction: this is the shadow party's **creator** disclosure, ratified at 01.05.01 D-03, and a creator is not an attester. 01.06.02:129 confirms a shadow party "is a subject, never an agent" and cannot attest at all, so no attester name is being published here.
items.openQuestionsRationale: None added. Every sub-question the collision could raise is already closed by the canonical source rather than left open: D-02's scope is absolute ("at any tier, to any viewer including authenticated professionals"), which settles the per-recipient EPK case without a new judgement, and DT-05 records the full reasoning for why the booker never needed the citer's name. Adding a tracked question here would reopen a decision the tree explicitly ratified.
verification: git diff confirms all five hunks land in 01.06.01 and 01.06.03; 01.06.02-credit-backed-portfolio.md has zero changes.
Markdown table column counts re-checked programmatically across both changed files — no mismatched rows in any table.

Sub-domain re-scanned for residual attester-naming prose. Remaining matches are only the canonical prohibitions in 01.06.02 (:39, :63, :211), the new negative statements, and one unrelated line about mandate-holder bio authorship (01.06.01:126).
Per prior remediation precedent (commit 65b48c3), 'Last updated' front-matter was left untouched — content is aligned to a ratified decision, not re-passed.
